description: Builds Redfish URIs locally and sends them to iLO to set or update a configuration attribute.

parameters.name: attribute_name
parameters.description: Name of the attribute to be configured.

parameters.name: attribute_value
parameters.description: Value of the attribute to be configured.

parameters.name: auth_token
parameters.description: Security token for authenticating to iLO.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: PEM formatted file that contains a CA certificate to be used for validation. Only used if validate_certs=true.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Command category to execute on iLO. Choices: "Manager"

parameters.name: ciphers
parameters.description: TLS/SSL Ciphers to use for the request. When a list is provided, all ciphers are joined in order with :. See the OpenSSL Cipher List Format for more details. The available ciphers is dependent on the Python and OpenSSL/LibreSSL versions.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: List of commands to execute on iLO.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests to iLO. Default: 10

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If false, TLS/SSL certificates are not validated. Set this to true to enable certificate checking. Should be used together with ca_path. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: Disable WINS Registration
  community.general.ilo_redfish_config:
    category: Manager
    command: SetWINSReg
    baseuri: 15.X.X.X
    username: Admin
    password: Testpass123
    attribute_name: WINSRegistration

- name: Set Time Zone
  community.general.ilo_redfish_config:
    category: Manager
    command: SetTimeZone
    baseuri: 15.X.X.X
    username: Admin
    password: Testpass123
    attribute_name: TimeZone
    attribute_value: Chennai

- name: Set NTP Servers
  community.general.ilo_redfish_config:
    category: Manager
    command: SetNTPServers
    baseuri: 15.X.X.X
    username: Admin
    password: Testpass123
    attribute_name: StaticNTPServers
    attribute_value: X.X.X.X

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Message with action result or error description. Returned: always Sample: "Action was successful"
